# Paint Drip

**Cover › Organic** · v1.0.0 · 72 frames at 30 fps (40–120)

Paint pours down from the top in uneven drips that join into a solid frame, then drains away to show the next scene.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/paint-drip@1.0.0.mp4) · [Alpha overlay for editing apps](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/paint-drip@1.0.0-overlay.mov)

## Where it is used

- Bold, messy, street-art looks
- Music and fashion edits
- Halloween and horror (in red)

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import paintDrip from './transitions/04-cover/organic/paint-drip';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(paintDrip, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 72 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing. It draws with WebGL, so render with `--gl=angle` (GPU) or `--gl=swangle` (no GPU).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | color | `"#FF4F1A"` |  | The incoming scene's background colour; the transition brings it in. |
| `drips` | integer | `14` | 4–40 | Number of drips. |
| `seed` | integer | `1` | 0–9999 | Changes the random layout. |
| `hold` | number | `0.1` | 0–0.4 | Share of the transition spent fully covered. |
